pages.text: Not all strangeness is new. Ancient Bones, Forgotten Ruins, Collapsed Observatories, Ancient Aqueducts, Gateway Ruins, Abandoned Archives, and crystal growths may surface in unstable or chance-born Ages. They do not banish exotic wonders; often the old and impossible stand shoulder to shoulder.

Bones speak of beasts from ages before memory. Ruins, observatories, aqueducts, and gateways whisper of peoples who mastered the impossible before we learned to name it. Archives are saddest of all, and among the most useful: their chests preserve Lost Pages.

Thus a single Age may feel both newborn and ancient: impossible geometry above, buried libraries below, and the traveler caught between wonder and archaeology with a shovel in one hand and a linking book in the other.
